data.name: Delia
data.long_meaning: Latin name Delia derives from the word delare, meaning ‘to reveal’, ‘to clear’, or ‘to shine’. In Roman mythology, Delia was a goddess of dawn and of childbirth. In Christianity, Delia is the name of several saints, including a martyr who lived in the 3rd century and a 16th-century Spanish nun.

The most notable saint Delia is a 3rd-century martyr who, along with three companions, suffered martyrdom for refusing to renounce her faith during the Roman persecutions. Another Saint Delia was a Spanish nun who dedicated her life to serving the poor, the sick, and the outcasts. The name Delia inspires a sense of clarity, revealing the truths of faith and leading us to the light of God.
